title: Chicken Casserole
description: One-dish chicken and rice: rice, cream of chicken soup and broth bake underneath seasoned chicken thighs, onion and green pepper.

ingredients.note: chopped — or a head of broccoli

steps.heading: Mix the Base
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Drizzle a large baking dish with a little olive oil. In the dish, stir together the rice, soup, broth, garlic powder and seasoned salt, then stir in the onion and green pepper.

steps.heading: Add the Chicken
steps.text: Lay the chicken thighs on top and season them with more garlic powder and seasoned salt.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Cover tightly and bake for 30 to 45 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.

notes: The original card gives no amounts for the chicken, onion, pepper or seasoning — the quantities here are a starting point. Uncooked rice can need closer to an hour: if it is still firm at 45 minutes, give it longer, still covered.
